title: A signal and a listener
hook: A sound is present in one toy condition.

knows: Animals can respond to cues and conditions.
doesNotKnow: In a toy comparison, a listener shelters after a call but stays exposed in the no-call condition. What differs in this stated example?

claims.text: In a toy comparison, a listener shelters after a call but stays exposed in the no-call condition. What differs in this stated example? The two panels show the same shelter but different stipulated listener locations after the cue. The comparison illustrates a possible listener response; it is not a field measurement and does not establish that all calls have the same effect.
